sections.kicker: Prepared for House of Abbeydale by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Abbeydale looks like a house with taste. The words do not yet say what it stands for.
sections.keep: The black and white photography and the spaced ABBEYDALE wordmark. Together they look like a house with taste.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: A new season of considered tailoring and timeless layers.
pins.what: The line under the headline describes any tailor.
pins.why: Considered and timeless are the words every tailor uses, so the sentence cannot tell Abbeydale from the shop down the street.
pins.how: Name what is particular to how Abbeydale cuts, fits or sources, in plain words.
pins.label: Your subline
pins.cost: Shoppers compare on cut and price, because the words give no other reason.

pins.area: Black and white mountain landscape fills the hero with no garment in it
pins.what: The hero is a landscape, not a piece of clothing.
pins.why: The mountain gives a mood, but nothing shows what Abbeydale makes or who wears it.
pins.how: Show a person in the clothes, in that same landscape.
pins.label: Your hero
pins.cost: The place and the product never meet.

pins.quote: OFFERINGS SUITING SHOP JOURNAL LOOKBOOKS STORY
pins.what: The menu holds six doors and none says what the house stands for.
pins.why: Offerings, suiting and shop overlap, and story sits last behind a dropdown, so the reason for Abbeydale is the hardest thing to find.
pins.how: Open with the story and group the rest under it.
pins.label: Your menu
pins.cost: New visitors never reach the part that sets the house apart.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at House of Abbeydale. I spent some time on your site. Three things stood out, and they point the same way.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on House of Abbeydale's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Loro Piana, from another category. It names the fibre and the place, so every line says something only it can.
